in_sanskrit.name: Promod
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Progress, Prosperity
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Promod एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Promod is derived from the Sanskrit word 'pramoda', which means 'to progress, to prosper'. It is a name that symbolizes growth, development, and success in all aspects of life. The name is often given to children who are born into prosperous families or those who are expected to make significant progress in their careers or personal lives.
